summary: Frontend-only test of the new Sketch pad and Resume Listening features at 390x844 with Playwright (mouse-drag drawing, a wrapped window.Audio to read player state, and localStorage inspection). SKETCH PASSED: every liver notes section (17 of 17) has a 'My sketches' row with a section-new-sketch-{id} button. A section with pictures (liver-s1) opens the picker with sketch-start-blank plus sketch-start-bg-x_liver_269 and x_liver_270. A section with no pictures (liver-s8) goes straight to /sketch/liver-s8. Tapping the backdrop closes the picker. Dragging creates SVG paths with the chosen ink and width (#D64545/9 by default, #2F6FDE/18, #2E9E5B/4). Undo removes the last stroke. Clear asks for confirmation (Cancel keeps the strokes, OK clears them). Save goes back to the topic and shows a thumbnail. A 2nd sketch in the same section shows 'My sketches (2)'. Both sketches survive a reload (key sono_study_sketches_v1). A draw-over-picture sketch shows the slide behind the strokes in both the editor and the thumbnail. Tapping a thumbnail opens 'Edit sketch' with its saved strokes, and edit+save updates the same sketch instead of creating a new one. Back with no changes leaves without a prompt. Back with unsaved strokes asks 'Leave without saving?' (Cancel stays, OK discards and the saved data is unchanged). Delete asks for confirmation and removes the sketch; the label goes back to 'My sketches'. RESUME LISTENING PASSED: no resume card at first. Playing liver-s2 for about 9s advanced currentTime to 8.8 and saved a spot about every 5s. Stopping shows resume-listening-button with 'Lobes of the Liver · 0:06'. The spot survives a reload, is per chapter (no resume card on /topic/spleen), and the card is hidden while audio plays. Tapping Resume plays liver-s2 from about 6s in read-all mode ('Stop reading'). Going back to home while playing saves the spot (0:13). Switching to the Mnemonics tab during read-all saves the s1 spot. When a single section finishes, the spot moves to the next section at 0:00. REGRESSION PASSED: the per-section speaker works. Mnemonics, quiz and flashcards have no sketch, speaker or resume UI. Home search (40 results for 'portal'), Saved and Progress load. No page errors. FAILED: (1) Opening or reloading an existing sketch directly by URL (/sketch/liver-s1?sketch=ID) shows 'Edit sketch' with an EMPTY canvas, and Save then overwrites the stored sketch with 0 strokes, so the user loses data. (2) On a sketch screen opened directly by URL (no history), Save and Back do nothing and the user is stuck. No deprecated packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner and expo-background-fetch are absent).

ui_bugs.component: Sketch editor: reload or open an existing sketch by URL
ui_bugs.issue: Opening /sketch/{sectionId}?sketch={id} directly or refreshing it gives a blank canvas, while the title already says 'Edit sketch'. Tapping Save then writes strokes: [] over the saved sketch, so the drawing is lost (reproduced: 2 strokes became 0 in sono_study_sketches_v1). RCA: in app/sketch/[sectionId].tsx:36-38, `existing` is undefined on first render because SketchProvider is still loading, and useState(existing?.strokes ?? []) only reads its initial value once. After the store loads, `existing` is set (title and Save target the real id) but `strokes` stays [].

ui_bugs.component: Sketch editor: Save/Back/Delete with no history
ui_bugs.issue: save(), close() and remove() call router.back() with no fallback (app/sketch/[sectionId].tsx:95,109,114). On a deep link or a refresh there is no history, so Save and Back do nothing and the URL stays on /sketch/... (reproduced). StackHeader's default handler already uses canGoBack() with router.replace, but the onBack override skips that.

issues: The ink swatches (sketch-ink-*) are 32x32, below the 44pt minimum touch target. Add hitSlop or enlarge them.
A new sketch can be saved with 0 strokes, which leaves an empty white thumbnail. Disable Save when strokes.length === 0 on a new sketch.

action_items: HIGH: In app/sketch/[sectionId].tsx, wait for useSketches().loaded before showing the editor, for example: if (!loaded) return a loader, then render an inner editor component that gets `existing` as a prop so its useState starts with the right strokes. Alternatively, add a one-time useEffect that calls setStrokes(existing.strokes) when `existing` first appears, and disable Save until loaded.
MEDIUM: Replace router.back() in save/close/remove with `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace(`/topic/${topicId}`)`.
LOW: Add hitSlop to the ink swatches so the touch target reaches 44pt. Disable Save for an empty new sketch.

LOW (code review): read-aloud stop() saves player.currentTime even when the new clip is still loading (between replace() and the first status update). That can save the previous clip's position against the new section. Save the position only if playingId === current, or use `from`.
critical_code_review_comments: Both stores call storage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(obj)) and JSON.parse on read: store/sketches.tsx:39 and store/progress.tsx:103. The storage helper already JSON-serializes values, so the data on disk is double-encoded and localStorage holds a quoted string. This is consistent, so it works, but it breaks the helper's documented contract ('never JSON.stringify/parse yourself').
The sketch canvas uses measureInWindow plus pageX/pageY. That is fine on this screen because it does not scroll, but it would break if the editor were ever placed inside a ScrollView.
The sketch id `sk-${Date.now()}` is fine for a single device.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (26/28 checks; 2 failures: deep-link edit data loss, deep-link back/save stuck)

seed_data_creation: None. All test sketches were made in throwaway browser contexts, and the ones I created were deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Values are double JSON-encoded in localStorage, so parse twice (JSON.parse(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sono_study_sketches_v1')))). The same applies to sono_study_progress_v1, whose .listen holds the resume spots. Draw by mouse move/down/move/up inside the visible '[data-testid="sketch-canvas"]:visible' bounding box. At 390x844 the canvas is about 366x488 at y=146; strokes that start outside it are ignored. Use page.on('dialog') to accept or dismiss window.confirm. Topic screens stay mounted, so always use :visible selectors (for example '[data-testid="sketch-screen"]:visible [data-testid="header-back-button"]'). For audio, wrap window.Audio and document.createElement('audio') in an init script. To reproduce the HIGH bug: save a sketch, page.goto('/sketch/liver-s1?sketch=<id>'), wait 2s, count the paths (0), then Save and check that localStorage now has 0 strokes. There is no /search route; search is the input on the home screen.
rca_of_issue: Deep-link data loss: SketchScreen sets its strokes state from getSketch() on the first render. SketchProvider loads AsyncStorage asynchronously, so on a cold load `existing` is undefined at mount and useState locks in []. When the store finishes loading, `existing` resolves, so the title becomes 'Edit sketch' and Save uses the existing id, but strokes stays empty, and saveSketch replaces the sketch with an empty one. Mitigation: gate the editor on `loaded`, or sync the state once `existing` appears. Stuck navigation: the onBack and save handlers call router.back() unconditionally.
